title: Father's Dying Words
next_chapter_hook: Those three words struck like thunder, and Chen Ji stared intently at the characters slowly emerging on the turtle shell—this was the only clue to breaking the seven hundred chapters of death prophecy, the final chip with which he gambled against fate.

text.content: The voice from the depths of the turtle shell seemed to traverse endless years, carrying a hoarse and gentle tone that made Chen Ji's heart stop. "Ji'er, if you can hear this message, your father... is no longer among the living." The voice trembled slightly, as if suppressing something. Chen Ji's grip on the turtle shell tightened sharply, his knuckles turning white. He opened his mouth, but found his throat blocked, unable to speak a single word. Everything around seemed to freeze—Su Qingyao's worried gaze, Ye Qing's confused expression, Mo Xiansheng's thoughtful stare—all receded into a vague backdrop.

dialogue.content: "I know you must hate me. Hate me for abandoning you in the sect as a servant, hate me for letting you endure hardships you should never have faced." The voice paused, as if taking a deep breath, "But I had no choice. The Tianji Record chose you—this is the fate of our Chen family... for generations."

text.content: Chen Ji's eye sockets burned with heat. As someone who had walked the world under the persona of a "waste," he had grown accustomed to hiding all emotions behind that calm, even cowardly mask. But now, that mask was crumbling inch by inch. He thought of many things—the days of being bullied in the servants' quarters, those mornings of being hungry yet still having to smile and comply, those late nights when he saw through everything yet had to pretend ignorance.

dialogue.content: "You must think our Chen family is just some declining minor clan, our ancestors once prosperous, now left with only a broken Tianji Record and endless debts." Father's voice suddenly carried a bitter smile, "You're wrong. Ji'er, our Chen family's bloodline does not belong to this world."

text.content: The surface of the turtle shell suddenly glowed with a faint golden light, and those originally blurry symbols began to slowly coalesce, transforming into flowing images. Chen Ji saw—in the endless void, a massive tree connecting heaven and earth, with a group of white-robed figures standing beneath it. They were surrounded by the aura of the Great Dao, and with every gesture, the rules of heaven and earth seemed ready to change. And at the roots of that tree, a tightly closed eye was coiled.

dialogue.content: "That is the Eye of Heavenly Dao." Father's voice turned grave, "In ancient times, our Chen family's ancestors were... bane to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. The Tianji Record was created specifically to seal it—a sacred artifact. However, the Eye of Heavenly Dao was too powerful. While destroying our ancestors, it also left a curse in our bloodline. Every successor of the Tianji Record would be marked by it."

text.content: The scene shifted again. Chen Ji saw his father—the man who in his memories was always taciturn, always shut away in his study—kneeling before an altar, drenched in blood. Before him floated a slowly opening vertical pupil, and in that vertical pupil was no emotion, only endless coldness and scrutiny. "Found you," the vertical pupil seemed to smile. "Another vessel."

dialogue.content: "I refused to let you become its vessel." Father's voice rang out again, this time carrying unprecedented resolve, "So I sent you to the Tianqing Sect, sealed your talent with a secret technique, letting you survive as a 'waste'. I thought, as long as you don't expose the Tianji Record's existence, it won't find you. But I was wrong. Ji'er, from the moment you were born, it has already seen you."

text.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly. He remembered those inexplicable nightmares, those suffocating sensations that jolted him awake in the depths of night, that trembling feeling of being watched every time he used the Tianji Record. So from the very beginning, he had never escaped the gaze of that eye. The surrounding air seemed to turn ice-cold, and even Su Qingyao couldn't help but shiver, instinctively moving closer to Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "But you are different from previous successors." Father's voice suddenly softened, "You not only inherited the Tianji Record, but also... her bloodline. Ji'er, you have a sister, Nian'er. When the Eye of Heavenly Dao pursued us, I separated and hid you both. Her being taken by the Holy Sect was no coincidence—it was the final trump card I left for you."

text.content: Chen Nian. A blurry figure surfaced in Chen Ji's mind, the sister he desperately wanted to find. So from the beginning, his father had been arranging pieces for him. The images on the turtle shell shifted once more, and Chen Ji saw a young girl imprisoned by chains deep within the Holy Sect, her tightly closed eyes surrounded by a ring of golden symbols identical to his own.

dialogue.content: "Nian'er is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight." Father's voice grew increasingly urgent, as if time was running out, "But this is also the key to breaking fate. Ji'er, you must find her. In your seven hundredth chapter prophecy, you will see your own death—but that is not set in stone. The method to break it lies hidden within Nian'er. The Tianji Record and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key share a life; only together can they break fate's grip."

text.content: The turtle shell began to shake violently, the golden light growing dimmer. Father's voice became fragmented, like a candle guttering in the wind. "In my whole life, I calculated all the secrets of heaven, yet ultimately could not calculate the human heart. Ji'er... I do not ask you to inherit my cause, only that you... walk a path of your own. Do not be bound by fate, do not be defined by prophecy. You are... you are our Chen family's... final hope..."

choice.prompt: Facing his father's dying words, Chen Ji felt a turbulent surge of complex emotions. How should he face his father's expectations and arrangements?

choices.description: Father used his life to pave the road for him, this deep affection must not be let down. He would bear the Chen family's mission and complete his father's unfinished cause.
choices.visible_cost: Lose oneself, bear a heavy fate
choices.visible_reward: Receive his father's complete Dao transmission, the Tianji Record's seal loosens further
choices.risk_hint: Risk being completely devoured by fate
choices.process_label: 继承父亲的意志与使命

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, letting tears slide down from the corners of his eyes. "Father, I will." His voice was soft, yet carried an unprecedented firmness. He pressed the turtle shell tightly against his chest, as if to preserve that warmth forever. Su Qingyao had never seen him like this, at a loss for words, could only silently stand by his side, conveying silent support with her body temperature.

choices.description: Father's arrangements were to protect him, but he refused to be a chess piece in anyone's hand, including his father's. He would walk a path that belonged to him alone.
choices.visible_reward: Break free from fate's predetermined track, gain true free will
choices.risk_hint: Lose father's protection, face unknown dangers alone

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, and in those pupils burned a light never seen before. "Father, you gave me life, gave me the Tianji Record, gave me the possibility to survive." His voice was calm, yet revealed an indisputable edge, "But from now on, I walk this road myself. The Eye of Heavenly Dao也好, fate也罢—Chen Ji from this day forward, lives only for himself." The golden light on the turtle shell completely faded, but that final warmth seemed branded into the depths of his soul.

choices.description: What Chen family bloodline, what Heavenly Fate inheritance, what nemesis of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—he wanted none of it. He only wanted to be an ordinary person, living a plain life with his sister.
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from fate's entanglements
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not spare him, his sister's situation becomes even more dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of madness, but also a hint of relief. "What Chen family ancestors, what Heavenly Fate inheritance, what nemesis of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—" he violently hurled the turtle shell toward the ground, "I don't want it! I only want to be a servant disciple, have food to eat, wait for Nian'er to return, find some place where no one knows us, live a stable life!" However, the turtle shell did not shatter; instead, after bouncing a few times on the ground, it stood firmly there, as if silently mocking his naivety. Mo Xiansheng sighed, and on that remnant soul's face, for the first time, appeared an expression of pity.

At that moment, the turtle shell flickered one final time, and in that already dim golden light, emerged the final line of text—a name, a name Chen Ji had never heard yet somehow felt inexplicably familiar. At the moment that name appeared, Chen Ji felt his Tianji Record suddenly shudder, as if something long sealed was awakening. He lowered his head to look at the golden symbols on his palm, where new information slowly emerged—the two characters "Share Life," like a burning brand, seared into the depths of his consciousness.
